changeSet.sql:
create or alter procedure metrics.CleanupExecutions as begin declare @completedOn datetime = dateadd(dd, -7, getutcdate()), @unCompletedOn datetime = dateadd(dd, -14, getutcdate()), @processingOn datetime = dateadd(dd, -2, getutcdate())
-- Removing completed data delete I from metrics.ExecutionItem I inner join metrics.Execution E on E.ID = I.Executionid and E.CompletedOn < @completedOn
delete from metrics.Execution where CompletedOn < @completedOn
-- Removing incomplete data delete I from metrics.ExecutionItem I inner join metrics.Execution E on E.ID = I.Executionid and E.StartedOn < @unCompletedOn and E.CompletedOn is null
delete from metrics.Execution where StartedOn < @unCompletedOn and CompletedOn is null
-- Clear any old / expired executions tha are still in a processing state. update metrics.execution set ProcessingStartedOn = null, Processing = 0, Failures = Failures + 1, ErrorMessage = coalesce(ErrorMessage, '') + '; Cleared Processing flag due to orphaned execution' where ProcessingStartedOn < @processingOn end
